scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,red "pnpm --filter @flex/back start:dev" "wait-on tcp:localhost:3001 && pnpm --filter @flex/front start"
scripts.lint: concurrently -n back,provider,front,shared -c blue,green,red,yellow "pnpm --filter @flex/back run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run lint" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run lint"
scripts.check: concurrently -n back,provider,front,shared -c blue,green,red,yellow "pnpm --filter @flex/back run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/front run check" "pnpm --filter @flex/shared run check"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flex/shared run build && concurrently -n back,provider,front -c blue,green,red "pnpm --filter @flex/back build" "pnpm --filter @flex/provider build" "pnpm --filter @flex/front build"
